decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the core yogurt range and its public recognition still justifies keeping it, even though it has not been mentioned on the website since 2019.

The Abendbrotkäse was showcased on the home page as a focus of the cheese direction, so management's public commitment and the need to justify it argue for persisting despite the lack of recent visibility.
The mild soft cheese was announced as rounding off the new cheese offer, and with two cheeses already cut, management can still attribute its weak visibility to temporary causes and keep it.

The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche and least promoted item, which makes it the likeliest candidate to be cut, but its place in the cheese range and the investment already made tilt management toward keeping it one more year.
